title: Confrontation at La Conga
summary: Subbing for Sacasas at La Conga, he faces down an owner's interference and stays on.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And Sacassas had the band La Conga. Sacassa got to go away for a couple weeks. So the man send for me. So I went over there. He said, I want you to work a couple of weeks here for Scassas. All right. (Inaudible).

So he say, well, you got (inaudible) open 2:00 o'clock in the afternoon until the rest of the show. I say all right. I got there with my band. His orchestra was close to the bar, close to the bandstand. I start rehearsing the act. He opened the door. (Inaudible) the office. Hey, hey, hey. This -- I stopped the man, said, what did you say? No, no, no, you don't play. I said, listen, I'm the leader of this orchestra. I'm a musician. You let me finish the rest of my show. I said, I don't play (inaudible) interfere with my music, you or nobody else. (Inaudible).

All right. So I play. And I'm going to play that night, the whole Broadway, will be the talk of Broadway. Oh, (inaudible). So the Havana (inaudible). Three days later (inaudible) to come and talk to me. So when I (inaudible) come to me, say, Mario, the chance you've been looking for. He said, a chance to open in Havana. (Inaudible) I say, I'm not interested. Why? I say, (inaudible) stay here two weeks. (Inaudible) go somewhere else. (Inaudible) he going to play. He ain't going to follow me. (Inaudible) go somewhere else. (Inaudible) go back over here. (Inaudible) no way he going to pay if he ain't going to follow me. (Inaudible) is a musician.
(Inaudible) get you out of here, man. Say, forget about it. No, you crazy. I say, well, all right, forget it. Two weeks -- I stay in that club three years and two months.
